f4hhSLEl2EE.description:
In this powerful message, Pastor Steve Abraham continues our BOLD FAITH series with a deep dive into Joshua 14:6-13. Caleb’s request to "Give Me This Mountain" wasn't just about land; it was a testament to 45 years of unwavering trust in God’s promises.

If you are facing "giants" or waiting for your own promised land, this message provides three practical pillars to help you move forward in faith:

WATCH YOUR WORDS – Caleb didn't speak from fear; he spoke from conviction. Learn how to align your speech with God’s truth over your life and family.

STAND ON THE PROMISES – Character is built on our relationship with the Word. Discover how to navigate the "wait" with the right attitude.

CONFRONT YOUR GIANTS – Stop tolerating generational cycles. It’s time to drive out the giants that stand between you and your spiritual inheritance.

God isn't done with your story yet. We hope this message encourages you to step into everything He has for you.
